lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਦਸਵਾ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa satigur miliai dasavaa duaar paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The outgoing, wandering soul, upon meeting the True Guru, opens the Tenth Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਥੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tithai a(n)mrit bhojan sahaj dhun upajai jit sabad jagat tha(n)mhi rahaaiaa ||
lines.translation: There, Ambrosial Nectar is food and the celestial music resounds; the world is held spell-bound by the music of the Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਅਨੇਕ ਵਾਜੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah anek vaaje sadaa anad hai sache rahiaa samaae ||
lines.translation: The many strains of the unstruck melody resound there, as one merges in Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਥੰਮੑਿਆ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak satigur miliai dhaavat tha(n)mhiaa nij ghar vasiaa aae ||4||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: by meeting the True Guru, the wandering soul becomes steady, and comes to dwell in the home of its own self. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man too(n) jot saroop hai aapanaa mool pachhaan ||
lines.translation: O my mind, you are the embodiment of the Divine Light - recognize your own origin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man har jee terai naal hai guramatee ra(n)g maan ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Dear Lord is with you; through the Guru's Teachings, enjoy His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mool pachhaanahi taa(n) sahu jaanahi maran jeevan kee sojhee hoee ||
lines.translation: Acknowledge your origin, and then you shall know your Husband Lord, and so understand death and birth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਤਾਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanahi taa(n) doojaa bhaau na hoee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, know the One; then, you shall not love any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ਵਜੀ ਵਧਾਈ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man saa(n)t aaee vajee vadhaaee taa hoaa paravaan ||
lines.translation: Peace comes to the mind, and gladness resounds; then, you shall be acclaimed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak man too(n) jot saroop hai apanaa mool pachhaan ||5||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: O my mind, you are the very image of the Luminous Lord; recognize the true origin of your self. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man too(n) gaarab atiaa gaarab ladiaa jaahi ||
lines.translation: O mind, you are so full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਭਵਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohanee mohiaa phir phir joonee bhavaahi ||
lines.translation: The fascinating Maya has fascinated you, over and over again, and lured you into reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaarab laagaa jaahi mugadh man a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaavahe ||
lines.translation: Clinging to pride, you shall depart, O foolish mind, and in the end, you shall regret and repent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaar tisanaa rog lagaa birathaa janam gavaavahe ||
lines.translation: You are afflicted with the diseases of ego and desire, and you are wasting your life away in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਗੈ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mugadh chetahi naahee agai gaiaa pachhutaavahe ||
lines.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh does not remember the Lord, and shall regret and repent hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਅਟਿਆ ਗਾਰਬਿ ਲਦਿਆ ਜਾਵਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak man too(n) gaarab atiaa gaarab ladiaa jaavahe ||6||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: O mind, you are full of pride; loaded with pride, you shall depart. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਤੂੰ ਮਤ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਹਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man too(n) mat maan karahi j hau kichh jaanadaa guramukh nimaanaa hohu ||
lines.translation: O mind, don't be so proud of yourself, as if you know it all; the Gurmukh is humble and modest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਉ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan hau budh hai sach sabad mal khohu ||
lines.translation: Within the intellect are ignorance and ego; through the True Word of the Shabad, this filth is washed off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਅਗੈ ਮਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hohu nimaanaa satiguroo agai mat kichh aap lakhaavahe ||
lines.translation: So be humble, and surrender to the True Guru; do not attach your identity to your ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਤ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai aha(n)kaar jagat jaliaa mat too(n) aapanaa aap gavaavahe ||
lines.translation: The world is consumed by ego and self-identity; see this, lest you lose your own self as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai bhaanai karahi kaar satigur kai bhaanai laag rahu ||
lines.translation: Make yourself follow the Sweet Will of the True Guru; remain attached to His Sweet Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਪੁ ਛਡਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak aap chhad sukh paavahi man nimaanaa hoi rahu ||7||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: renounce your ego and self-conceit, and obtain peace; let your mind abide in humility. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that time, when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa ana(n)d sahaj bhaiaa man tan sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I became so very blissful, and my mind and body found such a natural peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sahu chit aaiaa ma(n)n vasaaiaa avagan sabh visaare ||
lines.translation: My Husband Lord came into my consciousness; I enshrined Him within my mind, and I renounced all vice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੋਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tis bhaanaa gun paragat hoe satigur aap savaare ||
lines.translation: When it pleased Him, virtues appeared in me, and the True Guru Himself adorned me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਿਆ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan paravaan hoe jinhee ik naam diRiaa duteeaa bhaau chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings become acceptable, who cling to the One Name and renounce the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak dha(n)n s velaa jit mai satigur miliaa so sahu chit aaiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: blessed is the time when I met the True Guru, and my Husband Lord came into my consciousness. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜੰਤ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik ja(n)t bharam bhule tin sahi aap bhulaae ||
lines.translation: Some people wander around, deluded by doubt; their Husband Lord Himself has misled them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai phirahi haumai karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: They wander around in the love of duality, and they do their deeds in ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਿ ਸਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕੁਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin sahi aap bhulaae kumaarag paae tin kaa kichh na vasaaee ||
lines.translation: Their Husband Lord Himself has misled them, and put them on the path of evil. Nothing lies in their power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਇਹ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee gat avagat too(n)hai jaanahi jin ih rachan rachaaee ||
lines.translation: You alone know their ups and downs, You, who created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam teraa kharaa bhaaraa guramukh kisai bujhaae ||
lines.translation: The Command of Your Will is very strict; how rare is the Gurmukh who understands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak kiaa ja(n)t vichaare jaa tudh bharam bhulaae ||9||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: what can the poor creatures do, when You mislead them into doubt? ||9||
